webDesign.title: Mountain Bike
webDesign.description: The classic uphill timed segment on a mountain bike — no e-bikes. From SC Bodenmais clubhouse (750 m) up to Chamer Hütte (1,300 m), ~8 km and 550 m elevation gain.

development.title: Gravel Bike
development.description: The gravel category for those riding wide tyres and robust frames — also without motor assistance. Same route, separate timed classification.

consulting.title: Trail Running
consulting.description: Those who prefer to conquer mountains on foot compete in the running category. Same start, same summit — just in running shoes.

about.title: About Us
about.description: SC Bodenmais and the Arberblitz race.

story.title: Uphill — flat out or on your own two feet
story.text: The Arberblitz is SC Bodenmais's summer highlight. Every October, mountain bikers, gravel bikers and trail runners take on the route from Bodenmais to Chamer Hütte — 550 metres of climbing, around 8 kilometres, and a finish at 1,300 metres altitude.

quality.title: Community
quality.description: SC Bodenmais stands for sport, togetherness and joy of movement in nature.

transparency.title: Fairness
transparency.description: Clear rules, accurate timing, and open exchange among all participants.

innovation.title: Nature
innovation.description: The Bavarian Forest as a backdrop — the route runs through real mountain terrain.

accessibility.title: Open to all
accessibility.description: Whether competitive athlete or leisure rider — everyone is welcome at Arberblitz.
